summary: Central Puerto S.A. filed a Form 6-K on November 12, 2026 furnishing its third-quarter 2026 earnings presentation, an ordinary periodic disclosure by a foreign private issuer (the equivalent of a US earnings release on Form 8-K Item 2.02). The exhibit contains consolidated results and CAMMESA market variable references; no transaction, shareholder action, board recommendation, advisor, premium, or structural terms are disclosed. Signature by attorney-in-fact Leonardo Marinaro. No special situation is present; the only angle to watch is operating performance and any subsequent strategic commentary on the 20-F cycle.
